method: Visual reading of source scan; grammar cross-checks are not a fresh random output audit.

findings.decision: Preserve the source’s separate nasal and retroflex letters and explicit cluster spellings. Do not regularize vocabulary clusters from comparison forms or examples elsewhere in the grammar.
Sandhi, epenthesis and contextual voicing are grammatical alternations, not unconditional sound-profile replacements.
Comparative correspondences describe relations to other languages. Do not treat the tables as global Ollari substitutions or automatically asserted ancestry.
Plural endings have multiple classes, including stem alternations and replacement. Use printed full forms where available; do not concatenate every abbreviated ending blindly.
Gender generally distinguishes masculine and nonmasculine; numerals can distinguish masculine, feminine and neuter. Retain vocabulary f. n. scope rather than assigning a single sex.
Case affixes and oblique formations do not authorize indiscriminate lexical normalization.

scope: Grammar supplies interpretation and supporting citations; this pass does not add all grammatical examples as new lexical entries.
